{{Quote|One of Doss’s men told him all about Brightwater while they were heading over here from Yost’s ship.|Emperor's Hand Mara Jade|<ref name="Choices of One" />}}
In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> '''Bok Yost's ship''', which was equipped with an [[Engine/Legends|engine]], traveled where the [[Hand of Judgment]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] deserter group was held [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] by its owner, the [[Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] of [[Elegasso]], [[Bok Yost]].<ref name="Choices of One" />

Unbeknowst to Yost, the [[Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] secretly boarded his ship as well and managed to hear where Yost and his [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] where holding [[Korlo Brightwater]], one of the stormtroopers they captured.<ref name="Choices of One" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yost's ship was mentioned in the [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Choices of One" />
